A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 37-page versions of the same paper, with corresponding main sections, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–H. No material gaps prevent comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original hidden-state measurements, attention-head analyses and intervention experiments, including circuit ablations in Table 1 and additional empirical analyses in Appendices B–H.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and results, including the main circuit ablations, pre-training measurements and appendix investigations of in-weight learning.

M1.justification: The three-stage circuit—input text encoding, semantics merging, and feature retrieval and copying—is unchanged. The bypass mechanisms and early-exit centroid decoding procedure are also retained.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six classification datasets, the TEE control comparison and the same appendix scenarios, including prompts without the query's ground-truth label in the demonstrations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: zero-shot and random prediction references, random-connection ablations, LM-head versus centroid decoding, and contextual calibration remain in their corresponding comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 2.2 and Appendix A retain the same models, default four demonstrations, 512 test examples per dataset, 256-example centroid training, metrics, quantization settings and ablation procedures.

E4.justification: The circuit and shortcut ablations, delimiter sensitivity tests, pre-training analysis, direct-decoding investigations and in-weight-learning counterexample are retained. Appendices B–H introduce no new or revised analyses.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting remains unchanged, including mean and standard deviation for random-ablation controls in Tables 1 and 8. Neither version adds or revises run counts, seeds or statistical estimation procedures relative to the other.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results, plotted findings and qualitative observations are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 3 retains 66.19% accuracy for full LM-head inference and 84.27% for Layer34 centroid inference, with the latter's 2.38× speed.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations, including head overlap, kernel alignment, centroid classification and the appendix attention-based analysis, are unchanged. Equation typesetting adjustments in Appendix A do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims: a three-stage explanation of ICL, empirical evidence for its operations, explanations of observed phenomena, and a dominant circuit accompanied by bypass mechanisms.

C2.justification: Interpretations of label denoising, prediction bias, demonstration saturation and pre-training remain unchanged. Section 6 and Appendix G retain the same limitations concerning circuit granularity, classification-only coverage and generalization to in-weight learning.

D1.justification: The Reproducibility Statement replaces v2's promise to release code after acceptance with a specific official implementation repository, hc495/ICL_Circuit. The implementation and experimental details in Appendix A remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including comparisons with induction-circuit explanations, implicit gradient descent, kernel regression and Bayesian inference in Sections 2.1 and 6.

P1.justification: v3 makes small wording edits in Section 4.1, revises the author-contribution statement, adds reviewer acknowledgments and changes the header from under review to published. The section structure and scientific narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: There are small spacing and page-break adjustments, altered equation layout in Appendix A.4, and a blue-to-black change to the appendix title. Figures and tables retain their content, with only limited placement and formatting changes.

improvement.justification: The concrete implementation link in v3 replaces a future-release promise and improves the paper's reproducibility information. Scientific evidence, claims and limitations remain unchanged, so the gain is limited. The supplied PDFs do not establish the linked repository's completeness or usability.
